title: Mod Config
description: Configuration settings for a GearLoader Mod

modLoaderVersion.description: The version of GearLoader this mod was developed with. Specify this to ensure compatibility with future versions of GearLoader.

dependencies.description: A list of other mods required by this mod

name.description: Name of this dependency. This should match the name given to the mod loader by that mod's config.json

version.description: A version qualifier for this dependency. If none is specificed behavior defaults to ">=0.0.0"

optional.description: If `true` this mod will still load if the dependency is not installed, if `false` the mod loader will fail to load this mod if the dependency is not satisfied. Defaults to false.
